						p_u_82.ultraRecords[p_u_83] = v_u_92
					end
					p_u_82.newlyVisibleRecords[p_u_83] = v_u_92
					v_u_92.loaded = true
					local v104 = p_u_82
					v104.recordCount = v104.recordCount + 1
				end)
			end
		else
			if v90.parentReason == nil then
				p_u_82.newlyVisibleRecords[p_u_83] = p_u_82.records[p_u_83]
			end
			v90.parentReason = nil
			return
		end
	else
		return
	end
end
function v_u_2.ConfigureTags(p105) -- name: ConfigureTags
	for _, v106 in script.Parent:GetChildren() do
		local v107 = v106.Name
		if string.sub(v107, 1, 7) ~= "Detail_" then
			continue
		end
		local v108 = nil
		for _, v109 in p105.tagList do
			if v109.name ~= v107 then
				continue
			end
			v108 = v109
		end
		if v108 == nil then
			v108 = {
				["moves"] = false,
				["useGrid"] = true,
				["name"] = v107,
				["distance"] = 50
			}
			if p105.debugging == true then
				print("New Detail tag registered:", v107, " distance:", v108.distance, " moves:", v108.moves)
			end
			local v110 = p105.tagList
			table.insert(v110, v108)
		end
		v108.reparent = true
		v108.animate = true
		v108.moves = false
		if v106:GetAttribute("distance") ~= nil then
			v108.distance = v106:GetAttribute("distance")
		end
		if v106:GetAttribute("usegrid") == false then
			v108.useGrid = false
		end
		if v106:GetAttribute("animate") == false then
			v108.animate = false
		end
		if v106:GetAttribute("deparent") == false then
			v108.reparent = false
		end
		if v106:GetAttribute("moves") == true then
			v108.useGrid = false
			v108.moves = true
			v108.reparent = false
		end
		v108.configurationDistance = v108.distance
	end
	p105.largestGridDistance = 0
	for _, v111 in p105.tagList do
		if v111.useGrid ~= true or v111.distance <= p105.largestGridDistance then
			continue
		end
		p105.largestGridDistance = v111.distance
	end
end
function v_u_2.Setup(p_u_112) -- name: Setup
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_1, (copy) v_u_2
	if p_u_112.setup ~= true then
		p_u_112.setup = true
		p_u_112:ConfigureTags()
		for _, v_u_113 in p_u_112.tagList do
			for _, v114 in v_u_1:GetTagged(v_u_113.name) do
				v_u_2:OnDetailAdded(v114, v_u_113.distance, v_u_113.useGrid, v_u_113.moves, v_u_113.animate, v_u_113.reparent, v_u_113)
			end
			v_u_1:GetInstanceAddedSignal(v_u_113.name):Connect(function(p115)
				-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_2, (copy) v_u_113
				v_u_2:OnDetailAdded(p115, v_u_113.distance, v_u_113.useGrid, v_u_113.moves, v_u_113.animate, v_u_113.reparent, v_u_113)
			end)
			v_u_1:GetInstanceRemovedSignal(v_u_113.name):Connect(function(p116)
				-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_112, (ref) v_u_2
				local v117 = p_u_112.records[p116]
				if v117 then
					if not v117.parentReason then
						v_u_2:CleanupDetailRecord(v117)
					end
				end
			end)
		end
		for _, v118 in v_u_1:GetTagged("Imposter") do
			p_u_112:ImposterSetup(v118)
		end
		v_u_1:GetInstanceAddedSignal("Imposter"):Connect(function(p119)
			-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_112
			p_u_112:ImposterSetup(p119)
		end)
		p_u_112.cameraPreviousCFrame = workspace.CurrentCamera.CFrame
	end
end
function v_u_2.DrawUIText(p120, p121, p122, p123, p124) -- name: DrawUIText
	local v125 = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	v125.AutoLocalize = false
	v125.Text = p122
	v125.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	v125.TextSize = p124
	v125.TextColor3 = p123
	v125.Position = UDim2.new(0, p121.x, 0, p121.y)
	v125.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
	v125.TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Bottom
	v125.Parent = p120.debugGui
	local v126 = p120.debugTris
	table.insert(v126, v125)
	return v125
end
function v_u_2.ProcessDetailObject(p127, p128, p129) -- name: ProcessDetailObject
	if p128.loaded == false then
		return
	elseif p128.instanceSignal == nil or p128.instanceSignal.Connected == false then
		p127:CleanupDetailRecord(p128)
	else
		p127:UpdateVis(p128, p129)
		if p128.visible then
			if p128.moves then
				p127.visibleMovingDetails = p127.visibleMovingDetails + 1
				return
			end
			p127.visibleDetails = p127.visibleDetails + 1
		end
	end
end
function v_u_2.UpdateAnimations(p130, p131) -- name: UpdateAnimations
	debug.profilebegin("Update Animations")
	p130.detailsAnimating = 0
	for _, v132 in p130.animating do
		p130.detailsAnimating = p130.detailsAnimating + 1
		if v132.delayTime > 0 then
			v132.delayTime = v132.delayTime - p131 * p130.animSpeed
		else
			v132.transparency = v132.transparency + v132.dir * p131 * p130.animSpeed
			if v132.transparency < 0 then
				v132.transparency = 0
				p130.animating[v132.part] = nil
			end
			if v132.transparency > 1 then
				v132.transparency = 1
				p130.animating[v132.part] = nil
				if v132.reparent then
					if v132.parentRecord then
						v132.parentRecord.parentReason = "InternalDeparent"
					end
					v132.parentInstance.Parent = nil
				end
			end
		end
		v132.part.LocalTransparencyModifier = v132.transparency
	end
	for _, v133 in p130.animatingLights do
		p130.detailsAnimating = p130.detailsAnimating + 1
		if v133.delayTime > 0 then
			v133.delayTime = v133.delayTime - p131 * p130.animSpeed
		else
			v133.transparency = v133.transparency + v133.dir * p131 * p130.animSpeed
			if v133.transparency < 0 then
				v133.transparency = 0
				p130.animatingLights[v133.part] = nil
			end
			if v133.transparency > 1 then
				v133.transparency = 1
				p130.animatingLights[v133.part] = nil
				if v133.reparent == true then
					if v133.parentRecord then
						v133.parentRecord.parentReason = "InternalDeparent"
					end
					v133.parentInstance.Parent = nil
				end
			end
		end
		v133.part.Brightness = v133.brightness * (1 - v133.transparency)
	end
	debug.profileend()
end
function v_u_2.UpdateDetails(p_u_134, p_u_135, _) -- name: UpdateDetails
	if p_u_134.detailsDirty == false then
		return
	elseif p_u_134.processing ~= true then
		p_u_134.detailsDirty = false
		p_u_134.processing = true
		local v_u_136 = tick() + 0.001 * p_u_134.detailMsBudget
		task.spawn(function()
			-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_134, (copy) p_u_135, (ref) v_u_136
			debug.profilebegin("Update Details")
			p_u_134.visibleDetails = 0
			local v137 = p_u_134.largestGridDistance / p_u_134.gridSize.x
			local v138 = math.ceil(v137)
			local v139 = p_u_134.largestGridDistance / p_u_134.gridSize.y
			local v140 = math.ceil(v139)
			local v141 = p_u_134.largestGridDistance / p_u_134.gridSize.z
			local v142 = math.ceil(v141)
			local v143 = p_u_135.x / p_u_134.gridSize.x
			local v144 = math.floor(v143) - v138
			local v145 = p_u_135.y / p_u_134.gridSize.y
			local v146 = math.floor(v145) - v140
			local v147 = p_u_135.z / p_u_134.gridSize.z
			local v148 = math.floor(v147) - v142
			local v149 = p_u_135.x / p_u_134.gridSize.x
			local v150 = math.floor(v149) + v138
			local v151 = p_u_135.y / p_u_134.gridSize.y
			local v152 = math.floor(v151) + v140
			local v153 = p_u_135.z / p_u_134.gridSize.z
			local v154 = math.floor(v153) + v142
			debug.profilebegin("Update Grid")
			local v155 = {}
			for v156 = v144, v150 do
				for v157 = v146, v152 do
					for v158 = v148, v154 do
						local v159 = p_u_134.grid[Vector3.new(v156, v157, v158)]
						if not v159 then
							continue
						end
						for _, v160 in v159 do
							v155[v160.instance] = v160
							p_u_134.oldSet[v160.instance] = v160
						end
					end
				end
			end
			debug.profileend()
			local v161 = 0
			for _, v162 in p_u_134.oldSet do
				p_u_134:ProcessDetailObject(v162, p_u_135)
				v161 = v161 + 1
				if v161 <= 100 then
					continue
				end
				v161 = 0
				if v_u_136 >= tick() then
					continue
				end
				debug.profileend()
				task.wait()
				debug.profilebegin("Update Details")
				v_u_136 = tick() + 0.001 * p_u_134.detailMsBudget
			end
			p_u_134.oldSet = v155
			p_u_134.processing = false
			local v163 = 0
			for _, v164 in p_u_134.ultraRecords do
				p_u_134:ProcessDetailObject(v164, p_u_135)
				v163 = v163 + 1
				if v163 <= 100 then
					continue
				end
				v163 = 0
				if v_u_136 >= tick() then
					continue
				end
				debug.profileend()
				task.wait()
				debug.profilebegin("Update Details")
				v_u_136 = tick() + 0.001 * p_u_134.detailMsBudget
			end
			debug.profileend()
		end)
	end
end
function v_u_2.UpdateMovingDetails(p_u_165, p_u_166, _) -- name: UpdateMovingDetails
	task.spawn(function()
		-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_165, (copy) p_u_166
		debug.profilebegin("Update Moving Details")
		p_u_165.visibleMovingDetails = 0
		local v167 = tick() + 0.001 * p_u_165.detailMsBudget
		local v168 = 0
		for _, v169 in p_u_165.movingRecords do
			p_u_165:ProcessDetailObject(v169, p_u_166)
			v168 = v168 + 1
			if v168 <= 100 then
				continue
			end
			v168 = 0
			if v167 >= tick() then
				continue
			end
			debug.profileend()
			task.wait()
			debug.profilebegin("Update Moving Details")
			v167 = tick() + 0.001 * p_u_165.detailMsBudget
		end
	end)
end
function v_u_2.Update(p170, p171) -- name: Update
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_2
	debug.profilebegin("Update Detail Module")
	p170:Setup()
	local v172 = tick()
	for _, v173 in p170.debugTris do
		v173:Destroy()
	end
	p170.debugTris = {}
	local v174
	if p170.centerOnPlayer == true and (game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character ~= nil and game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character.PrimaryPart ~= nil) then
		v174 = game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character.PrimaryPart.Position
	else
		v174 = game.Workspace.CurrentCamera.CFrame.Position
	end
	if p170.cameraPreviousPos == nil then
		p170.cameraPreviousPos = v174
	end
	local v175 = (v174 - p170.cameraPreviousPos).Magnitude
	p170.cameraPreviousPos = v174
	if v_u_2.teleportSize < v175 then
		if p170.debugging == true then
			print("Camera teleported!")
		end
		p170.detailsDirty = true
		p170.supressAnimationFrames = p170.supressAnimationFrames + 1
	end
	if p170.gridPreviousPos == nil then
		p170.gridPreviousPos = v174
	end
	local v176 = v174 - p170.gridPreviousPos
	if p170.detailsDirty == false and v176.Magnitude > p170.stepSize then
		p170.gridPreviousPos = v174
		p170.detailsDirty = true
	end
	p170.lastCameraPos = v174
	p170:UpdateNewlyVisibleDetails(v174)
	p170:UpdateDetails(v174, p171)
	p170:UpdateMovingDetails(v174, p171)
	p170:UpdateImposters(v174)
	p170:UpdateAnimations(p171)
	if p170.processing == false and p170.supressAnimationFrames > 0 then
		p170.supressAnimationFrames = p170.supressAnimationFrames - 1
	end
	local v177 = (tick() - v172) * 10000
	p170:DrawDebugText((math.floor(v177)))
	debug.profileend()
end
function v_u_2.UpdateNewlyVisibleDetails(p178, p179) -- name: UpdateNewlyVisibleDetails
	for _, v180 in p178.newlyVisibleRecords do
		if v180.isModel == nil then
			continue
		end
		p178:ClearAnimations(v180)
		if (p178:GetPosition(v180) - p179).magnitude > v180.distance then
			v180.visible = false
			if v180.lodModel ~= nil then
				v180.lodModel.Parent = v180.parent
			end
			if v180.reparent == true then
				v180.parentReason = "InternalDeparent"
				v180.instance.Parent = nil
			else
				p178:SnapRecordToTransparent(v180)
			end
		else
			v180.visible = true
			if v180.lodModel ~= nil then
				if v180.reparent == true then
					v180.lodModel.Parent = nil
				else
					v180.lodModel.Parent = v180.parent
					p178:SnapRecordLODModelToTransparent(v180)
				end
			end
			v180.instance.Parent = v180.parent
		end
	end
	p178.newlyVisibleRecords = {}
end
function v_u_2.DrawDebugText(p181, p182) -- name: DrawDebugText
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_2
	debug.profilebegin("DrawDebugText")
	if p181.drawDebugText == true then
		local v183 = p182 / 10
		local v184 = tostring(v183)
		local v185 = v183 < 0.1 and "0.0" or v184
		if p181.debugGui == nil then
			local v186 = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
			v186.Parent = game.Players.LocalPlayer.PlayerGui
			v186.ResetOnSpawn = false
			v186.IgnoreGuiInset = true
			v186.Name = "DebugGui"
			p181.debugGui = v186
		end
		p181.visibleImposterQuads = 0
		p181.visibleImposterModels = 0
		local v187 = 0
		for _, v188 in p181.imposters do
			v187 = v187 + 1
			if v188.showModel == false then
				p181.visibleImposterQuads = p181.visibleImposterQuads + 1
			else
				p181.visibleImposterModels = p181.visibleImposterModels + 1
			end
		end
		local v189 = 76
		p181:DrawUIText(Vector3.new(10, v189, 0), "Num Details: (" .. p181.visibleDetails + p181.visibleMovingDetails .. "/" .. p181.recordCount .. ") (" .. v_u_2.pendingLoads .. ")", Color3.new(0, 1, 0), 8)
		local v190 = v189 + 14
		p181:DrawUIText(Vector3.new(10, v190, 0), "Animating: " .. p181.detailsAnimating, Color3.new(0, 1, 0), 8)
		local v191 = v190 + 14
		p181:DrawUIText(Vector3.new(10, v191, 0), "Imposter Models vs Quads: (" .. p181.visibleImposterModels .. " vs " .. p181.visibleImposterQuads .. ")", Color3.new(0, 1, 0), 8)
		local v192 = v191 + 14
		p181:DrawUIText(Vector3.new(10, v192, 0), "Imposter Updates: " .. p181.imposterUpdates, Color3.new(0, 1, 0), 8)
		local v193 = v192 + 14
		p181:DrawUIText(Vector3.new(10, v193, 0), "Detail CPU: " .. v185 .. "ms.", Color3.new(0, 1, 0), 8)
		local v194 = v193 + 14
		if p181.forceDisabled then
			p181:DrawUIText(Vector3.new(10, v194, 0), "FORCE DISABLED", Color3.new(1, 0, 0), 8)
		end
		local _ = v194 + 14
	end
	p181.imposterUpdates = 0
	debug.profileend()
end
function v_u_2.UpdateImposters(p_u_195, p_u_196) -- name: UpdateImposters
	if p_u_195.impostersUpdating ~= true then
		p_u_195.impostersUpdating = true
		coroutine.wrap(function()
			-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_195, (copy) p_u_196
			local v197 = tick() + 0.001 * p_u_195.imposterMsBudget
			local v198 = 0
			for _, v199 in p_u_195.imposters do
				v198 = v198 + 1
				if v198 > 100 and v197 < tick() then
					v197 = tick() + 0.001 * p_u_195.imposterMsBudget
					task.wait()
					v198 = 0
				end
				p_u_195:UpdateImposter(v199, p_u_196)
			end
			p_u_195.impostersUpdating = false
		end)()
	end
end
function v_u_2.ImposterSetup(p200, p201) -- name: ImposterSetup
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_2
	if p200.imposters[p201] == nil then
		local v202 = {
			["instance"] = p201,
			["parent"] = p201.Parent,
			["animate"] = true
		}
		local v203 = p201:GetAttribute("animate")
		if v203 ~= nil then
			v202.animate = v203
		end
		v202.showModel = true
		v202.reparent = true
		v202.distanceCulled = false
		v202.imposterDistance = p201:GetAttribute("distance") or v_u_2.imposterDistance
		v202.imposterMaxDistance = p201:GetAttribute("maxdistance") or v_u_2.imposterMaxDistance
		if v202.imposterMaxDistance < v202.imposterDistance then
			v202.imposterMaxDistance = v202.imposterDistance + 100
		end
		v_u_2.imposters[p201] = v202
	end
end
function v_u_2.UpdateImposterSize(_, p204) -- name: UpdateImposterSize
	local v205, v206 = p204.instance:GetBoundingBox()
	local v207 = v206.x
	local v208 = v206.z
	local v209 = math.max(v207, v208) * 1.414213
	local v210 = v206.y
	local v211 = math.max(v209, v210) * p204.scale
	for _, v212 in p204.parts do
		p204.surface:Clone().Parent = v212
		v212.Size = Vector3.new(0.00001, v211, v211)
		v212.Position = v205.Position
		v212.Parent = p204.lodModel
		v212.Transparency = 1
	end
	p204.offset = v205.Position - p204.instance:GetModelCFrame().Position
	p204.storedBounds = v206
	p204.pivot = p204.instance:GetPivot()
	p204.quadPivot = p204.pivot + p204.pivot.YVector * p204.pivot.YVector:Dot(v205.Position - p204.pivot.Position)
	p204.largest = v211
	return v205, v206
end
function v_u_2.UpdateImposter(p213, p_u_214, p215) -- name: UpdateImposter
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_2
	if p_u_214.surface == nil then
		if #p_u_214.instance:GetChildren() == 0 then
			return
		end
		local v216 = p_u_214.instance:GetAttribute("HasImposter")
		if v216 ~= nil and (v216 == true and p_u_214.instance:FindFirstChild("Imposter", true) == nil) then
			return
		end
		local v217 = p_u_214.instance:FindFirstChild("Imposter", true)
		if v217 == nil then
			if p213.folder == nil then
				return
			end
			local v218 = p213.folder:FindFirstChild(p_u_214.instance.Name)
			if not v218 then
				return
			end
			v217 = v218:Clone()
			v217.Parent = p_u_214.instance
		end
		p_u_214.surface = v217:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("SurfaceAppearance")
		if p_u_214.surface ~= nil then
			p_u_214.parts = {}
			for v219 = 1, 16 do
				local v220 = v_u_2.quads:FindFirstChild("Quad" .. v219):Clone()
				p_u_214.parts[v219] = v220
				v220.Position = p_u_214.instance:GetModelCFrame().Position
				v220.CastShadow = v217.CastShadow
			end
			p_u_214.scale = 1
			local v221 = v217:GetAttribute("scale")
			if v221 ~= nil and (tonumber(v221) ~= nil and v221 > 0) then
				p_u_214.scale = v221
			end
			v217:Destroy()
			local v222 = Instance.new("Model")
			v222.Name = p_u_214.instance.Name .. "_Imp"
			v222.Parent = p_u_214.parent
			p_u_214.lodModel = v222
			p_u_214.descendantAddedSignal = p_u_214.instance.DescendantAdded:Connect(function()
				-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_214
				if p_u_214.storedBounds ~= nil then
					local _, v223 = p_u_214.instance:GetBoundingBox()
					if (p_u_214.storedBounds - v223).magnitude > 0 then
						p_u_214.storedBounds = nil
					end
				end
			end)
			p_u_214.ang = 0
		end
	end
	if p_u_214.surface == nil then
		return
	end
	if p_u_214.storedBounds == nil then
		p213:UpdateImposterSize(p_u_214)
	end
	local v224 = p_u_214.pivot.Position
	local v225 = p215 - v224
	local v226 = p_u_214.showModel
	p_u_214.showModel = false
	local v227 = v225.Magnitude
	local v228 = (p213.debugSupression == true or p213.forceDisabled) and 0 or v227
	if p_u_214.imposterMaxDistance < v228 then
		if p_u_214.lodModel.Parent ~= nil then
			p_u_214.lodModel.Parent = nil
			p_u_214.distanceCulled = true
		end
	elseif p_u_214.distanceCulled == true then
		p_u_214.distanceCulled = false
		if p_u_214.lodModel.Parent == nil then
			p_u_214.lodModel.Parent = p_u_214.instance.Parent
			p_u_214.showModel = true
		end
	end
	if v228 < p_u_214.imposterDistance then
		p_u_214.showModel = true
	end
	if p_u_214.showModel == false then
		local v229 = v225.Unit.y
		if math.abs(v229) > p213.imposterVerticalAngleTolerance then
			p_u_214.showModel = true
		end
	end
	if p_u_214.showModel ~= v226 then
		if p_u_214.showModel == false then
			p213:AnimateRecord(p_u_214, 1 * p213.imposterAnimSpeed)
		end
		if p_u_214.showModel == true then
			p_u_214.instance.Parent = p_u_214.parent
			p213:AnimateRecord(p_u_214, -1 * p213.imposterAnimSpeed)
		end
	end
	if p_u_214.showModel == false then
		local v230 = p_u_214.pivot:PointToObjectSpace(p215)
		local v231 = v230.X

local function v_u_34(p29) -- name: isSdkReady
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_4, (copy) v_u_2
	local v30 = p29.playerId or nil
	local v31 = p29.needsInitialized or true
	local v32 = p29.shouldWarn or false
	local v33 = p29.message or ""
	if v31 and not v_u_4.Initialized then
		if v32 then
			v_u_2:w(v33 .. " SDK is not initialized")
		end
		return false
	end
	if v31 and (v30 and not v_u_4:isEnabled(v30)) then
		if v32 then
			v_u_2:w(v33 .. " SDK is disabled")
		end
		return false
	end
	if not v31 or (not v30 or v_u_4:sessionIsStarted(v30)) then
		return true
	end
	if v32 then
		v_u_2:w(v33 .. " Session has not started yet")
	end
	return false
end

function v_u_1.addBusinessEvent(_, p_u_46, p_u_47) -- name: addBusinessEvent
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_3, (copy) v_u_4, (copy) v_u_34, (copy) v_u_28, (copy) v_u_1, (copy) v_u_24, (copy) v_u_7, (copy) v_u_9, (copy) v_u_6
	v_u_3:performTaskOnGAThread(function()
		-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_4, (ref) v_u_34, (copy) p_u_46, (ref) v_u_28, (ref) v_u_1, (copy) p_u_47, (ref) v_u_24, (ref) v_u_7, (ref) v_u_9, (ref) v_u_6
		if v_u_4:isEventSubmissionEnabled() then
			if v_u_34({
				["playerId"] = nil,
				["needsInitialized"] = true,
				["shouldWarn"] = false,
				["message"] = "Could not add business event",
				["playerId"] = p_u_46
			}) then
				local v48 = p_u_47.amount or 0
				local v49 = p_u_47.itemType or ""
				local v50 = p_u_47.itemId or ""
				local v51 = p_u_47.cartType or ""
				local v52 = v48 * 0.7 * 0.35

				local v54 = p_u_47.gamepassId or nil
				v_u_7:addBusinessEvent(p_u_46, "USD", v53, v49, v50, v51)

					local v56 = v_u_6:GetPlayerDataFromCache(p_u_46)
					if not v56.OwnedGamepasses then

					end

					table.insert(v57, v54)
					v_u_6.PlayerCache[p_u_46] = v56
					v_u_6:SavePlayerData(v55)
				end
				return
			elseif p_u_46 then
				v_u_28(p_u_46, v_u_1.addBusinessEvent, v_u_1, p_u_46, p_u_47)
			else

		end
	end)

function v_u_1.PlayerJoined(_, p_u_89) -- name: PlayerJoined
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_6, (copy) v_u_14, (copy) v_u_13, (copy) v_u_7, (copy) v_u_4, (copy) v_u_8, (copy) v_u_2, (copy) v_u_1, (ref) v_u_15, (copy) v_u_12, (copy) v_u_10, (copy) v_u_16, (copy) v_u_21
	local v90 = p_u_89:GetJoinData().TeleportData
	local v91 = v_u_6:GetPlayerData(p_u_89)
	local v92
	if v90 then
		v92 = v90.gameanalyticsData
		if v92 then
			local v93 = v90.gameanalyticsData
			local v94 = p_u_89.UserId
			v92 = v93[tostring(v94)]
		end
	else
		v92 = nil
	end
	local v95 = v_u_6:GetPlayerDataFromCache(p_u_89.UserId)
	if v95 then
		if v92 then
			v95.SessionID = v92.SessionID
			v95.SessionStart = v92.SessionStart
		end
		v95.PlayerTeleporting = false
	else
		local v96, v97 = v_u_14.invokeClient("getPlatform", p_u_89, 5)
		local v98 = not v96 and "unknown" or v97
		for v99, v100 in pairs(v_u_6.BasePlayerData) do
			v91[v99] = v91[v99] or v100
		end
		local function v101()
			-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_13, (copy) p_u_89
			return v_u_13:GetCountryRegionForPlayerAsync(p_u_89)
		end
		local v102, v103 = pcall(v101)
		if v102 then
			v91.CountryCode = v103
		end
		v_u_6.PlayerCache[p_u_89.UserId] = v91
		local v104
		if v98 == "Console" then
			v104 = "uwp_console"
		elseif v98 == "Mobile" then
			v104 = "uwp_mobile"
		else
			local _ = v98 == "Desktop"

		return v599

			local v_u_239 = nil

					-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_239
					v_u_239 = p240
				end), 2, 3 }, function(p241, p242)
				return p241 + p242
			end, 0)
			v_u_239(1)
			expect(v_u_1.is(v243)).to.equal(true)
			expect(v243:getStatus()).to.equal(v_u_1.Status.Resolved)
			expect(v243:expect()).to.equal(6)
		end)
		it("should always return a promise even if the list or reducer don\'t use them", function()
			-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_1, (ref) v_u_6
			local v247 = v_u_1.fold({ 1, 2, 3 }, function(p244, p245, p246)
				-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_1
				if p246 == 2 then
					return v_u_1.delay(1):andThenReturn(p244 + p245)
				else
					return p244 + p245
				end
			end, 0)
			expect(v_u_1.is(v247)).to.equal(true)
			expect(v247:getStatus()).to.equal(v_u_1.Status.Started)
			v_u_6(2)
			expect(v247:getStatus()).to.equal(v_u_1.Status.Resolved)
			expect(v247:expect()).to.equal(6)
		end)
		it("should return the first rejected promise", function()
			-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_1
			local v251 = v_u_1.fold({ 1, 2, 3 }, function(p248, p249, p250)
				-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_1
				if p250 == 2 then
					return v_u_1.reject("foo")
				else
					return p248 + p249
				end
			end, 0)
			expect(v_u_1.is(v251)).to.equal(true)
			local v252, v253 = v251:awaitStatus()
			expect(v252).to.equal(v_u_1.Status.Rejected)
			expect(v253).to.equal("foo")
		end)
		it("should return the first canceled promise", function()
			-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_1
			local v_u_254 = nil
			local v258 = v_u_1.fold({ 1, 2, 3 }, function(p255, p256, p257)
				-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_254, (ref) v_u_1
				if p257 == 1 then
					return p255 + p256
				end
				if p257 == 2 then
					v_u_254 = v_u_1.delay(1):andThenReturn(p255 + p256)
					return v_u_254
				end
				error("this should not run if the promise is cancelled")
			end, 0)
			expect(v_u_1.is(v258)).to.equal(true)
			expect(v258:getStatus()).to.equal(v_u_1.Status.Started)
			v_u_254:cancel()
			expect(v258:getStatus()).to.equal(v_u_1.Status.Cancelled)
		end)
	end)
	describe("Promise.race", function()
		-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_1
		it("should resolve with the first settled value", function()
			-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_1
			local v260 = v_u_1.race({ v_u_1.resolve(1), v_u_1.resolve(2) }):andThen(function(p259)
				expect(p259).to.equal(1)

		end)
		it("should cancel other promises", function()
			-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_1
			local v261 = v_u_1.new(function() end)
			v261:andThen(function() end)
			local v263 = { v261, v_u_1.new(function() end), v_u_1.new(function(p262)
					p262(2)
				end) }
			local v264 = v_u_1.race(v263)
			expect(v264:getStatus()).to.equal(v_u_1.Status.Resolved)
			expect(v264._values[1]).to.equal(2)
			expect(v263[1]:getStatus()).to.equal(v_u_1.Status.Started)
			expect(v263[2]:getStatus()).to.equal(v_u_1.Status.Cancelled)
			expect(v263[3]:getStatus()).to.equal(v_u_1.Status.Resolved)
			local v265 = v_u_1.new(function() end)
			expect(v_u_1.race({ v_u_1.reject(), v_u_1.resolve(), v265 }):getStatus()).to.equal(v_u_1.Status.Rejected)
			expect(v265:getStatus()).to.equal(v_u_1.Status.Cancelled)
		end)
		it("should error if a non-array table is passed in", function()
			-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_1
			local function v266()
				-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_1
				v_u_1.race(v_u_1.new(function() end))
			end
			local v267, v268 = pcall(v266)
			expect(v267).to.be.ok()
			expect(v268:find("Non%-promise")).to.be.ok()
		end)
		it("should cancel promises if it is cancelled", function()
			-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_1
			local v269 = v_u_1.new(function() end)
			v269:andThen(function() end)
			local v270 = { v_u_1.new(function() end), v_u_1.new(function() end), v269 }
			v_u_1.race(v270):cancel()
			expect(v270[1]:getStatus()).to.equal(v_u_1.Status.Cancelled)
			expect(v270[2]:getStatus()).to.equal(v_u_1.Status.Cancelled)
			expect(v270[3]:getStatus()).to.equal(v_u_1.Status.Started)
		end)
	end)

	describe("Promise.tap", function()

	describe("Promise.some", function()
		-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_1
		it("should resolve once the goal is reached", function()
			-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_1
			local v306 = v_u_1.some({ v_u_1.resolve(1), v_u_1.reject(), v_u_1.resolve(2) }, 2)
			expect(v306:getStatus()).to.equal(v_u_1.Status.Resolved)
			expect(v306._values[1][1]).to.equal(1)
			expect(v306._values[1][2]).to.equal(2)
		end)
		it("should error if the goal can\'t be reached", function()
			-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_1
			expect(v_u_1.some({ v_u_1.resolve(), v_u_1.reject() }, 2):getStatus()).to.equal(v_u_1.Status.Rejected)
			local v_u_307 = nil
			local v309 = v_u_1.some({ v_u_1.resolve(), v_u_1.new(function(_, p308)
					-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_307
					v_u_307 = p308
				end) }, 2)
			expect(v309:getStatus()).to.equal(v_u_1.Status.Started)
			v_u_307("foo")
			expect(v309:getStatus()).to.equal(v_u_1.Status.Rejected)
			expect(v309._values[1]).to.equal("foo")
		end)
		it("should cancel pending Promises once the goal is reached", function()
			-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_1
			local v_u_310 = nil
			local v311 = v_u_1.new(function() end)
			local v313 = v_u_1.new(function(p312)
				-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_310
				v_u_310 = p312
			end)
			local v314 = v_u_1.some({ v311, v313, v_u_1.resolve() }, 2)
			expect(v314:getStatus()).to.equal(v_u_1.Status.Started)
			expect(v311:getStatus()).to.equal(v_u_1.Status.Started)
			expect(v313:getStatus()).to.equal(v_u_1.Status.Started)
			v_u_310()
			expect(v314:getStatus()).to.equal(v_u_1.Status.Resolved)
			expect(v311:getStatus()).to.equal(v_u_1.Status.Cancelled)
			expect(v313:getStatus()).to.equal(v_u_1.Status.Resolved)
		end)
		it("should error if passed a non-number", function()
			-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_1
			expect(function()
				-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_1
				v_u_1.some({}, "non-number")
			end).to.throw()
		end)
		it("should return an empty array if amount is 0", function()
			-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_1

		it("should not return extra values", function()

		it("should cancel promises if it is cancelled", function()

			v317:andThen(function() end)
			local v318 = { v_u_1.new(function() end), v_u_1.new(function() end), v317 }

			it("should error if all are rejected", function()

	end)
	describe("Promise.allSettled", function()

	describe("Promise.each", function()
		-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_1
		it("should iterate", function()
			-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_1
			local v342, v343 = v_u_1.each({
				"foo",
				"bar",
				"baz",
				"qux"
			}, function(...)
				return { ... }
			end):_unwrap()
			expect(v342).to.equal(true)
			expect(v343[1][1]).to.equal("foo")
			expect(v343[1][2]).to.equal(1)
			expect(v343[2][1]).to.equal("bar")
			expect(v343[2][2]).to.equal(2)
			expect(v343[3][1]).to.equal("baz")
			expect(v343[3][2]).to.equal(3)
			expect(v343[4][1]).to.equal("qux")
			expect(v343[4][2]).to.equal(4)
		end)
		it("should iterate serially", function()
			-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_1
			local v_u_344 = {}
			local v_u_345 = {}
			local v351 = v_u_1.each({ "foo", "bar", "baz" }, function(p_u_346, p347)
				-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_345, (ref) v_u_1, (copy) v_u_344
				v_u_345[p347] = (v_u_345[p347] or 0) + 1
				return v_u_1.new(function(p_u_348)
					-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_344, (copy) p_u_346
					local v349 = v_u_344
					local function v350()
						-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_348, (ref) p_u_346
						p_u_348(p_u_346:upper())
					end
					table.insert(v349, v350)
				end)
			end)
			expect(v351:getStatus()).to.equal(v_u_1.Status.Started)
			expect(#v_u_344).to.equal(1)
			expect(v_u_345[1]).to.equal(1)
			expect(v_u_345[2]).to.never.be.ok()
			table.remove(v_u_344, 1)()
			expect(v351:getStatus()).to.equal(v_u_1.Status.Started)
			expect(#v_u_344).to.equal(1)
			expect(v_u_345[1]).to.equal(1)
			expect(v_u_345[2]).to.equal(1)
			expect(v_u_345[3]).to.never.be.ok()
			table.remove(v_u_344, 1)()
			expect(v351:getStatus()).to.equal(v_u_1.Status.Started)
			expect(v_u_345[1]).to.equal(1)
			expect(v_u_345[2]).to.equal(1)
			expect(v_u_345[3]).to.equal(1)
			table.remove(v_u_344, 1)()
			expect(v351:getStatus()).to.equal(v_u_1.Status.Resolved)
			local v352 = expect
			local v353 = v351._values[1]
			v352((type(v353))).to.equal("table")
			local v354 = expect
			local v355 = v351._values[2]
			v354((type(v355))).to.equal("nil")
			local v356 = v351._values[1]
			expect(v356[1]).to.equal("FOO")
			expect(v356[2]).to.equal("BAR")
			expect(v356[3]).to.equal("BAZ")
		end)

local function v_u_250(p234, p235) -- name: validateSkinOwnership

	["Storable"] = function(p371, p372) -- name: Storable
		-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_9, (copy) v_u_396
		if type(p371) == "boolean" then
			return p371
		end
		if type(p371) == "number" then
			return p371
		end
		if type(p371) == "string" then
			if not utf8.len(p371) then
				error("UTF8", 2)
				return p371
			end
		else
			if type(p371) == "buffer" then
				return p371
			end
			if type(p371) == "table" then
				if type(p371) ~= "table" then
					error("table", 2)
				end
				if getmetatable(p371) ~= nil then
					error("metatable", 2)
				end
				local v373 = p372 or {}
				if v373[p371] then
					error("Loop", 2)
				end
				v373[p371] = true
				local v374 = rawlen(p371)
				if v374 <= 0 then
					for v375, v376 in pairs(p371) do
						if type(v375) ~= "string" then
							error(("KeyString $%*"):format((("[%*]"):format((v_u_9(v375))))), 2)
						end
						if not utf8.len(v375) then
							error(("KeyUTF8 $%*"):format((("[%*]"):format((v_u_9(v375))))), 2)
						end
						local v377 = v_u_396.Storable
						local v378, v379 = pcall(v377, v376, v373)
						if v378 then
							continue
						end
						local v380 = tostring(v379)
						local v381, v382 = string.match(v380, "^(.*:%d+): (.+)$")
						if v381 then
							v380 = v382 or v380
						end
						local v383, v384 = string.match(v380, "^(.+) $(%[.+)$")
						if v383 then
							if not v384 then
								v383 = v380
							end
						else
							v383 = v380
						end
						error(("%* $%*"):format(v383, (("[%*]%*"):format(v_u_9(v375), v384 or ""))), 2)
					end
					return p371
				end
				local v385 = 0
				for v386, v387 in pairs(p371) do
					v385 = v385 + 1
					if v386 ~= v385 then
						error(("IndexMismatch $%*"):format((("[%*]"):format((v_u_9(v386))))), 2)
					end
					if v374 < v385 then
						error(("IndexOverflow $%*"):format((("[%*]"):format(v385))), 2)
					end
					local v388 = v_u_396.Storable
					local v389, v390 = pcall(v388, v387, v373)
					if v389 then
						continue
					end
					local v391 = tostring(v390)
					local v392, v393 = string.match(v391, "^(.*:%d+): (.+)$")
					if v392 then
						v391 = v393 or v391
					end
					local v394, v395 = string.match(v391, "^(.+) $(%[.+)$")
					if v394 then
						if not v395 then
							v394 = v391
						end
					else
						v394 = v391
					end
					error(("%* $%*"):format(v394, (("[%*]%*"):format(v385, v395 or ""))), 2)
				end
				if v374 ~= v385 then
					error("LengthMismatch", 2)
					return p371
				end
			else
				error("Storable", 2)
			end
		end
		return p371
	end

function v_u_396.Networkable(p398, p399) -- name: Networkable
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_9, (copy) v_u_396, (copy) v_u_397
	if type(p398) == "string" then
		if not utf8.len(p398) then
			error("UTF8", 2)
			return p398
		end
	elseif type(p398) == "table" then
		if type(p398) ~= "table" then
			error("table", 2)
		end
		if getmetatable(p398) ~= nil then
			error("metatable", 2)
		end
		local v400 = p399 or {}
		if v400[p398] then
			error("Loop", 2)
		end
		v400[p398] = true
		local v401 = rawlen(p398)
		if v401 <= 0 then
			for v402, v403 in pairs(p398) do
				if type(v402) ~= "string" then
					error(("KeyString $%*"):format((("[%*]"):format((v_u_9(v402))))), 2)
				end
				if not utf8.len(v402) then
					error(("KeyUTF8 $%*"):format((("[%*]"):format((v_u_9(v402))))), 2)
				end
				local v404 = v_u_396.Networkable
				local v405, v406 = pcall(v404, v403, v400)
				if v405 then
					continue
				end
				local v407 = tostring(v406)
				local v408, v409 = string.match(v407, "^(.*:%d+): (.+)$")
				if v408 then
					v407 = v409 or v407
				end
				local v410, v411 = string.match(v407, "^(.+) $(%[.+)$")
				if v410 then
					if not v411 then
						v410 = v407
					end
				else
					v410 = v407
				end
				error(("%* $%*"):format(v410, (("[%*]%*"):format(v_u_9(v402), v411 or ""))), 2)
			end
			return p398
		end
		local v412 = 0
		for v413, v414 in pairs(p398) do
			v412 = v412 + 1
			if v413 ~= v412 then
				error(("IndexMismatch $%*"):format((("[%*]"):format((v_u_9(v413))))), 2)
			end
			if v401 < v412 then
				error(("IndexOverflow $%*"):format((("[%*]"):format(v412))), 2)
			end
			local v415 = v_u_396.Networkable
			local v416, v417 = pcall(v415, v414, v400)
			if v416 then
				continue
			end
			local v418 = tostring(v417)
			local v419, v420 = string.match(v418, "^(.*:%d+): (.+)$")
			if v419 then
				v418 = v420 or v418
			end
			local v421, v422 = string.match(v418, "^(.+) $(%[.+)$")
			if v421 then
				if not v422 then
					v421 = v418
				end
			else
				v421 = v418
			end
			error(("%* $%*"):format(v421, (("[%*]%*"):format(v412, v422 or ""))), 2)
		end
		if v401 ~= v412 then
			error("LengthMismatch", 2)
			return p398
		end
	elseif not v_u_397[typeof(p398)] then
		error("Networkable", 2)
	end
	return p398
end
function v_u_396.Enum(p_u_423) -- name: Enum
	if typeof(p_u_423) ~= "Enum" then
		error("Enum", 2)
	end
	return function(p424)
		-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_423
		if typeof(p424) ~= "EnumItem" then
			error("EnumItem", 2)
		end
		if p424.EnumType ~= p_u_423 then
			local v425 = p_u_423
			error(tostring(v425), 2)
		end
		return p424
	end
end
function v_u_396.EnumValue(p426) -- name: EnumValue
	if typeof(p426) ~= "Enum" then
		error("Enum", 2)

local function v_u_432(p417, p418, p419, _, _) -- name: BuildImageLayer

function v_u_67._writeMotion(p376, p377, p378, p379, p380, p381) -- name: _writeMotion

	p376.Sampled[p377] = true
	local v382 = p376.Samples[p377]

	if v382 then
		v383 = v382.T
	else
		v383 = v382

	local v384
	if v382 then

	else

	if v382 then

		local v391

		end

		end

	end
	if not v384 or (not v383 or (p381 <= v383 or p381 - v383 > 250)) then
		p376.Candidates[p377] = nil

	end

	local v395 = v393.Magnitude < 0.002 and Vector3.new(0, 0, 0) or v393
	if v394.Magnitude < 0.02 and v395 == Vector3.new(0, 0, 0) then
		p376.Candidates[p377] = nil
		return false, v390
	end
	local v396 = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
	local v397, v398
	if v395 == Vector3.new(0, 0, 0) and (v386 and (v385 and (v385 < v383 and v383 - v385 <= 250))) then
		v397, v398 = v_u_9.accelerating(v386.Position, v384.Position, p380.Position, v385 / 1000, v383 / 1000, p381 / 1000)

			v398 = v396
			v397 = v394
		end
	else
		v398 = v396
		v397 = v394
	end
	local v399 = {
		["PropId"] = nil,
		["T"] = nil,
		["Base"] = nil,
		["W"] = nil,
		["V"] = nil,
		["A"] = nil,
		["Hits"] = 0,
		["PropId"] = p379,
		["T"] = p381,
		["Base"] = p380,
		["W"] = v395,
		["V"] = v397,
		["A"] = v398
	}
	local v400
	if not p376.Untrusted[p377] then
		p376.Motions[p377] = v399
		v404, v405, v406, v407 = v_u_7.quantizeRotation(p380)
		v408 = p376.SentCFrames[p377]
		if not v408 then
			v408 = {}
			p376.SentCFrames[p377] = v408
		end
		v409 = v408[p379]
		if v409 == nil or (v409.K ~= v404 or (v409.A ~= v405 or v409.B ~= v406)) then
			v400 = false
		else
			v400 = v409.C == v407
		end
		v408[p379] = {
			["Position"] = p380.Position,
			["K"] = v404,
			["A"] = v405,
			["B"] = v406,
			["C"] = v407
		}
		v410 = p376.Stream
		v410:Time(p381)
		v_u_9.write(v410.W, p378, p379, p380, v395, v397, v398, v400)
		v410:EndRecord()
		v411 = p376.LastSent[p377]
		if v411 then
			v411[p379] = p381
		end
		return true, v390
	end
	local v401 = p376.Candidates[p377]
	p376.Candidates[p377] = v399
	if not v401 then
		return false, v390
	end
	local v402
	if p381 < v401.T then
		v402 = false
	else
		local v403 = v_u_9.at(v401.Base, v401.W, v401.V, v401.A, (p381 - v401.T) / 1000)
		v402 = not v_u_9.apart(v403, p380, 0.2, 0.02)
	end
	if not v402 then
		return false, v390
	end
	p376.Untrusted[p377] = nil
	p376.Candidates[p377] = nil
	p376.Motions[p377] = v399
	local v404, v405, v406, v407 = v_u_7.quantizeRotation(p380)
	local v408 = p376.SentCFrames[p377]
	if not v408 then
		v408 = {}
		p376.SentCFrames[p377] = v408
	end
	local v409 = v408[p379]
	if v409 == nil or (v409.K ~= v404 or (v409.A ~= v405 or v409.B ~= v406)) then
		v400 = false
	else
		v400 = v409.C == v407
	end
	v408[p379] = {
		["Position"] = p380.Position,
		["K"] = v404,
		["A"] = v405,
		["B"] = v406,
		["C"] = v407
	}
	local v410 = p376.Stream
	v410:Time(p381)
	v_u_9.write(v410.W, p378, p379, p380, v395, v397, v398, v400)
	v410:EndRecord()
	local v411 = p376.LastSent[p377]
	if v411 then
		v411[p379] = p381
	end
	return true, v390
end
function v_u_67._checkMotions(p412) -- name: _checkMotions
	-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_28
	local v413 = p412.Clock()
	local v414 = {}
	for v415 in p412.Motions do
		if p412.Sampled[v415] then
			continue
		end
		table.insert(v414, v415)
	end
	for _, v416 in v414 do
		local v417 = p412.Motions[v416]
		local v418 = p412.Ids[v416]
		if v418 then
			local v419 = v_u_28(v416, "CFrame")
			p412.LastCFrame[v416] = v419
			p412:_writeProp(v416, v418, v417.PropId, v419, v413)
		else
			p412.Motions[v416] = nil
		end
	end
	table.clear(p412.Sampled)
end

function v_u_67._untrack(p424, p425) -- name: _untrack
	local v426 = p424.Kinds[p425]
	if v426 == "joint" or (v426 == "weld" or v426 == "constraint") then

	p424.Motions[p425] = nil

	p424.Candidates[p425] = nil

function v_u_67._untrackTree(p431, p432, p433) -- name: _untrackTree
	local v434
	if p433 then
		local v435 = p431.Kids[p433]
		if v435 then
			v435[p432] = nil
			v434 = { p432 }
		else
			v434 = { p432 }
		end
	else
		v434 = { p432 }
	end
	while #v434 > 0 do
		local v436 = table.remove(v434)
		local v437 = p431.Kids[v436]
		if v437 then
			for v438 in v437 do
				table.insert(v434, v438)
			end
			p431.Kids[v436] = nil
		end
		p431:_untrack(v436)
	end
end

function v_u_67._discover(p443, p444, p445) -- name: _discover

			return

			p443:_track(p444, p445)
		end
	end

function v_u_67._walk(p450, p451) -- name: _walk
	-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_28
	local v452 = p450.Registry
	local v453 = p450.Pending
	while #v453 > 0 do
		if p451 <= os.clock() then
			return false
		end
		local v454 = table.remove(v453)
		local v455 = v_u_28(v454, "Parent")
		if v455 == nil then
			continue
		end
		if v452:MatchFilter(v454, v455) then
			p450:_watchFiltered(v454)
		else
			p450:_discover(v454, p450.Clock())
			if v454:IsA("Animator") then
				p450.WatchAnimator(v454)
			end
			if v454:IsA("BillboardGui") or v454:IsA("SurfaceGui") or p450:_inBaked(v454) then
				continue
			end
			for _, v456 in v454:GetChildren() do
				table.insert(v453, v456)
			end
		end
	end
	return true
end

end

function v_u_67._watchPath(p_u_472, p473, p_u_474) -- name: _watchPath
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_40, (copy) v_u_471, (ref) v_u_28
	if next(p_u_474.Children) ~= nil then
		local v_u_475 = v_u_40()
		p_u_472.Watches[p473] = v_u_475
		local function v_u_478(p476) -- name: check
			-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_475, (ref) v_u_471, (copy) p_u_472, (copy) p_u_474, (ref) v_u_28
			if v_u_475.Kids[p476] then
				v_u_475.Kids[p476] = nil

				else
					p_u_472:_watchPath(p476, v477)
				end
			end
		end
		local function v480(p_u_479) -- name: added
			-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_475, (copy) v_u_478
			if not v_u_475.Names[p_u_479] then
				v_u_475.Names[p_u_479] = p_u_479:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Name"):Connect(function()
					-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_478, (copy) p_u_479
					v_u_478(p_u_479)
				end)
				v_u_478(p_u_479)
			end
		end
		local v481 = v_u_475.Connections
		local v482 = p473.ChildAdded
		table.insert(v481, v482:Connect(v480))
		local v483 = v_u_475.Connections
		local v484 = p473.ChildRemoved
		local function v487(p485)
			-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_475, (ref) v_u_471, (copy) p_u_472
			local v486 = v_u_475.Names[p485]
			if v486 then
				v486:Disconnect()
				v_u_475.Names[p485] = nil
			end

				v_u_475.Kids[p485] = nil
				v_u_471(p_u_472, p_u_472.Watches, p485)
			end
		end
		table.insert(v483, v484:Connect(v487))
		for _, v488 in p473:GetChildren() do

		end
	end
end

function v_u_67._holdParticleHost(p545, p546) -- name: _holdParticleHost

function v_u_67._releaseParticleHost(p549, p550) -- name: _releaseParticleHost
	local v551 = p549.ParticleHosts[p550]
	if v551 then
		v551.Count = v551.Count - 1
		if v551.Count <= 0 then
			p549.ParticleHosts[p550] = nil
			if v551.Watch then
				for _, v552 in v551.Watch.Connections do
					v552:Disconnect()
				end
			end
			if p549.PinSignals[p550] and not (p549.CharacterScopes[p550] or (p549.Baked[p550] or p549.Unbaked[p550])) then
				p549:_unpin(p550)
			end
		end
	else
		return
	end
end

	end

function v_u_67.WriteEmit(p567, p568, p569, p570) -- name: WriteEmit
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_11, (copy) v_u_7
	if p567.Destroyed or not p567:_inDomain(p568) then
		return false
	end
	local v571 = p567.Registry
	local v572 = v571.NextId
	local v573 = {}
	local v574
	if p567:_inBaked(p568) then
		while p568 and (p568 ~= workspace and not p567:_isBakedRoot(p568)) do
			local v575 = p568.Name
			table.insert(v573, 1, v575)

		end

function v_u_67._poll(p686, p687) -- name: _poll
	-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_28, (copy) v_u_54
	local v688 = p687.List
	local v689 = p687.Set
	local v690 = #v688
	if v690 == 0 then
		return
	end

	local v693 = p687.Cursor
	local v694 = p686.Clock()

	while v695 < math.min(v690, 400) and os.clock() < v692 do

		end

		end
		v693 = v693 + 1
		local v698 = v_u_28(v696, "CFrame")
		local v699 = p686.LastCFrame[v696]

function v_u_67._followedRoot(p701, p702) -- name: _followedRoot

function v_u_67._lerpUnits(p707, p708, p709) -- name: _lerpUnits
	local v710 = p708 - p707.LastCameraTime
	if not p709 or (v710 <= 0 or v710 > 300) then
		return 0
	end
	local v711 = v710 / 10
	local v712 = math.round(v711)
	return math.clamp(v712, 1, 255)
end
function v_u_67._flushCamera(p713) -- name: _flushCamera

function v_u_67._flushFollow(p724, p725, p726) -- name: _flushFollow
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_54, (copy) v_u_11, (copy) v_u_7
	local v727 = p725.CFrame
	local v728 = p725.Fov
	local v729 = v727.Position - p725.RootPosition
	local v730 = p725.Focus - p725.RootPosition
	local v731 = p724.Follow
	local v732 = v727.Rotation
	local v733
	if v731 and v731.Root == p726 then
		v733 = 0
		if v_u_54(v731.Rotation.Rotation, v732.Rotation) then
			v733 = bit32.bor(v733, 4)
		else
			v732 = v731.Rotation
		end
		if (v731.Focus + v732 * v731.Offset - v729).Magnitude > 0.02 then
			if (v730 - v731.Focus).Magnitude > 0.02 then
				v733 = bit32.bor(v733, 1)
			else
				v730 = v731.Focus
			end
			v733 = bit32.bor(v733, 2)
		end
		local v734 = v728 - v731.Fov
		if math.abs(v734) >= 0.05 then
			v733 = bit32.bor(v733, 8)
		end
		if v733 == 0 then
			return
		end
	else
		v733 = 15
	end
	local v735
	if bit32.btest(v733, 2) then
		v735 = v732:VectorToObjectSpace(v729 - v730)
	else
		v735 = v731.Offset
	end
	local v736 = p724.Clock()
	local v737
	if v731 == nil then
		v737 = false
	else
		v737 = v731.Root == p726
	end
	local v738 = p724:_lerpUnits(v736, v737)
	local v739 = {
		["Root"] = p726,
		["Focus"] = v730,
		["Offset"] = v735,
		["Rotation"] = v732
	}
	local v740
	if bit32.btest(v733, 8) then
		v740 = v728
	else
		v740 = v731.Fov
	end
	v739.Fov = v740
	p724.Follow = v739
	p724.LastCamera = nil
	p724.LastCameraTime = v736
	local v741 = p724.Stream
	v741:Time(v736)
	local v742 = v741.W
	v742:u8(v_u_11.CameraFollow)
	v742:u8(v738)
	v_u_7.varuint(v742, p724.Ids[p726])
	v742:u8(v733)
	if bit32.btest(v733, 1) then
		v742:f32(v730.X)
		v742:f32(v730.Y)
		v742:f32(v730.Z)
	end
	if bit32.btest(v733, 2) then
		v742:f32(v735.X)
		v742:f32(v735.Y)
		v742:f32(v735.Z)
	end
	if bit32.btest(v733, 4) then
		v_u_7.rotation(v742, v_u_7.quantizeRotation(v732))
	end
	if bit32.btest(v733, 8) then
		v742:f32(v728)
	end
	v741:EndRecord()
end
function v_u_67.TrackCharacter(p743, p744) -- name: TrackCharacter

	end
end

function v_u_67._pollBaked(p747) -- name: _pollBaked
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_19, (copy) v_u_54, (ref) v_u_28, (copy) v_u_23
	local v748 = p747.Clock()
	for v749 in p747.Baked do
		local v750 = p747.Ids[v749]
		if not (v750 and v749:IsA("Model")) then
			continue
		end
		local v751 = v749:GetAttribute(v_u_19)
		local v752 = v749:GetPivot()
		if typeof(v751) == "CFrame" then
			v752 = v752 * v751:Inverse()
		end
		local v753 = p747.LastCFrame[v749]
		if v753 and not v_u_54(v753, v752) then
			continue
		end
		p747.LastCFrame[v749] = v752
		local v754 = p747:_propId(v_u_28(v749, "ClassName"), v_u_23)
		if not v754 then
			continue
		end
		p747:_writeProp(v749, v750, v754, v752, v748, true)
	end
end
